philippines.title: Magnitude 4.2 earthquake jolts Occidental Mindoro
philippines.description:
CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A magnitude 4.2 earthquake jolted parts of Occidental and Oriental Mindoro on Sunday afternoon, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). Phivolcs said the earthquake occurred at 4:05 p.m., with its epicenter located 11 kilometers south-southwest of Mamburao, Occidental Mindoro. The quake had a depth of 24 kilometers. Instrumental Intensity II was recorded in Mamburao and Sablayan, Occidental Mindoro, and Instrumental Intensity I in Looc and Abra de Ilog in the same province. In neighboring Oriental Mindoro, Intensity I was recorded in Calapan City and Puerto Galera. Phivolcs did not report any damage […]...

philippines.title: Landslides, floods disrupt travel in N. Luzon as 'habagat' rains persist
philippines.description:
TUGUEGARAO CITY — Incessant rains due to the southwest monsoon (habagat) triggered landslides, road closures and rising river levels across Cagayan Valley and the Cordillera region on Sunday. In Cagayan, the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 3rd District Engineering Office reported that Itawes Bridge 1 in Maguiling, Piat, and Itawes Bridge 2 in Tuao were impassable due to the elevated water level of the Chico River. Warning signs were installed to direct motorists to alternate routes. One alternative route is through the Aquib (Tatanep)-Dugayong Bridge in Piat for those traveling to Puregold Tuao.
